prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. One complete high-fidelity desktop screen of 在场, 1536x1024 landscape. A real long conversation, not a cover, not a storyboard. Explore a substantially different composition from a character at the left plus large white card: the whole page is a continuous editorial reading space with a delicate architectural edge. Content and interaction occupy at least three quarters; a narrow close view of warm wood, a brass desk lamp and a soft curtain belong at the peripheral edge. No large full-body or half-body character; Sakiko is present through an independently drawn 44px portrait by her answer and her small meme cat lying on the edge of the composer. The blank wall/reading plane is intentionally composed, has no rounded outer card, no rectangle floating over a full room. Quiet young literary anime art and exceptionally elegant interface craft. Warm daytime natural light. No green UI; no green buttons, no grey panel stack, no harsh blocks, no “hero” giant headline. Keep body comfortable and genuinely readable, headers modest.
Reference 1: mood, material and paint only, freedom to change room and camera completely. Reference 2: exact approved youthful Sakiko identity blue-lilac hair, golden eyes, navy ribbons, bright small smile, not mature face. Reference 3: same companion in simple cartoon cat form, no realistic fur.
Global navigation horizontally at top: 在场, 聊天 今天 留下, search/new/portrait icons. Central continuous reading column, aligned gutter for speaker identity and small sources in the margin; use whitespace and fine rules to organize. No individual bubble per paragraph. The user question remains visible above the answer, has a quiet different typographic treatment, no enormous card.
Content:
“为什么二阶方程需要两个初始条件？这两份讲义讲的是同一件事吗？”
Small attached objects with titles “微分方程讲义 · 12页” “相空间笔记 · 3页”.
Answer by 祥子:
“先把位置和速度分开看。”
“只知道某一刻在哪里，还不能决定它接下来往哪边走。二阶方程给出加速度与当前状态的关系；要选出一条具体轨迹，还需要起点的位置与速度。”
y″ + y = 0
y(t) = A cos t + B sin t
y(0) = A, y′(0) = B
“这里的 A 和 B 并非额外添加的限制，而是所有解之间的两种独立差别。初始条件把这两个自由量确定下来。”
subhead “把两份材料接起来”
“讲义把它写成一个二阶方程；相空间笔记把同一关系写成 x′=v，v′=−x。两者的初始状态都是一个点 (x₀,v₀)。选择这个点，才确定了从哪里、朝什么方向出发。”
A modest phase-circle drawing integrated inline, thin navy and copper strokes, not a chart card. One phrase selected shows just small local “问这句” affordance. Composer integrated into lower reading edge, single field with draft “如果只给位置，会剩下哪些可能？” and attachment plus/send icons. Source click should look like a linked document, not irrelevant decorative book.
This candidate explores comfortable continuous reading and modest companionship, contrasting a face-heavy table scene. Make it distinctive, spacious but not empty, crafted and intimate without illustration dominating. Need clear visual relation between sources, selected sentence and same input. Do not add new dashboards or side menus.
review: 采用连续阅读与边缘场景关系，导航沿现有产品；数学图不作为事实数据。
